title: senecio squalidus subsp. aurasiacus
intro: Senecio squalidus subsp. aurasiacus, commonly known as Ox-eye Hawkweed or Goldilocks, is a plant species in the dandelion family with bright yellow daisy-like flowers. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and anti-hemorrhagic properties. The therapeutic actions of Senecio squalidus subsp. aurasiacus include its ability to reduce inflammation, promote wound healing, and act as a diuretic. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenoid lactones, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
